name: @granturismo/devicespecs
description: A strongly-typed, modern TypeScript/JavaScript client library for the DeviceSpecs API. Query structured, clean, and normalized specifications, chipsets, and physical metrics for over 12,000 mobile devices.

scripts.build: tsc --module commonjs --outDir dist && tsc --module esnext --outDir dist/esm && mv dist/esm/index.js dist/index.mjs 2>/dev/null || true

author: GranTurismo
